scripts.build:deps: npm run build --workspace @icloud-hme/server && npm run build --workspace @icloud-hme/web
scripts.package:win: npm run build:deps && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --dir --win --x64
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:deps && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --dir --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:deps && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:deps && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --mac dmg zip

build.//: The backend runs in a real Node child process, not in Electron, so its native modules (better-sqlite3) must stay built for Node's ABI — never rebuild them for Electron.

mac.//: Arch is deliberately left to electron-builder's default (the host's): the bundled Node runtime and better-sqlite3 are native, so an Apple Silicon machine can only build an Apple Silicon app. Signing is also left to the default — no Developer ID is needed for a local build; set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false to skip it entirely.
